answer: Each submission hangs on the willow of a task receipt, and the whisper is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, reset on any identity-link attempt, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Reaching the kernel of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys.
